text:
Asha (CS): Starting Aurora onboarding thread. Goals: sandbox connectivity, SSO + KMS configured, and a sample end-to-end chat test within 14 days. Who volunteers for owners?
Derek (CSM): I'll own stakeholder comms, success criteria, and renewal watch. Propose weekly 20-min sync Fri 9am PT.
Kai (Aurora): Kai here 12 platform lead. Main blocking items: our network ops need the peering CIDR and a short permit to open inbound for smoke tests. Also need guidance on token limits.
Rui (Solutions): I'll be tech lead. Can Aurora share a small sample conversation and expected QPS? Also prefer we pick a default generation model to test.
Lena (Security): I'll drive compliance sign-off. If Aurora needs long audit retention, note policy and export options. Also ask if any regulated data will be in prompts.
Asha (CS): Owners: Derek -> comms & success criteria; Rui -> integration lead & perf baseline; Lena -> security sign-off & questionnaire; Asha -> milestones and onboarding board. Kai -> provide CIDRs, SSO contact, and sample convo.
Kai (Aurora): SSO contact: sso@aurora.tech. We'll send sample convo + CIDR by EOD tomorrow. No regulated data expected.
Rui (Solutions): Suggested timeline:
Day 0: Kickoff + collect SSO/KMS/CIDR
Day 3: Sandbox provisioned + basic auth smoke
Day 7: E2E chat test + perf baseline
Day 10: Observability dashboard + runbook draft
Day 14: Enablement + sign-off
Asha (CS): Risks: - If security questionnaire extends >10 days, raise renewal-watch flag. - Firewall change windows often take 48-72h.
Derek (CSM): Proposed success criteria: authenticated calls from Aurora sandbox; p95 < target latency for chat flows; dashboard reflects cost per convo within target; recorded enablement session.
Kai (Aurora): We'll aim to have artifacts by EOD tomorrow.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Aurora Onboarding Deep-dive" tomorrow 10:30am PT. Link: https://zoom.redwood-internal/meet/aurora-onboard
Asha (CS): Can Rui + Kai join that deep-dive? Focus: network, KMS, and sample payloads.
Rui (Solutions): Yes I can. Pre-reqs: SAML/OIDC metadata, sample message, CIDR, QPS estimate.
Lena (Security): Ill skim the security questionnaire before the meeting and flag any high-impact asks.
Asha (CS): Next steps: 1) Aurora shares artifacts (EOD tomorrow), 2) Rui prepares test plan, 3) Derek adds calendar invite cadence and renewal checkpoints. Well reconvene after the deep-dive and publish the Week 1 plan. :white_check_mark:
